leadIn: After completing this lesson, you will be able to:
objectives: Implement a Vue Router instance and integrate it into a Vue application.
Configure route definitions to map URL paths to corresponding Vue components.
Render navigation links using the <router-link> component for declarative routing.
Control component display by placing the <router-view> component in the application template.
Manipulate the router programmatically to navigate between views using methods like push.
Initialize and bind dynamic route parameters to component props for data-driven views.
Apply nested route configurations to structure complex page layouts with multiple router-view outlets.
